title: Flux Quantization on M-Strings
summary: The electric Gauss law in 11D SuGra is famously non-linear, whence its flux quantization must be in nonabelian cohomology. We have previously shown that the minimal admissible choice is 4-Cohomotopy, which in the presence of magnetized M5-probes takes its relative twistorial form. Here we discuss how this situation is further refined in the presence of M-string probes on the M5-worldvolume.
